_comment: SYNTHETIC non-sales and borderline conversations for testing the sales/not-sales gate.

lines: Hey! How was your weekend? Did you end up going to the lake?
Yeah, we did. It rained the whole time but the kids loved it.
Ha, that's classic. We just stayed home and watched movies.
Sounds nice honestly. Are you coming to Rina's birthday on Saturday?
Definitely. I'll bring the cake. What time does it start?
Around six. Bring the kids too.
Thank you for calling Brightnet support, how can I help?
My internet has been dropping every evening for three days now.
I'm sorry about that. Can you restart the router and tell me which lights are blinking?
Okay, it's restarted. The power light is green and the internet light is red.
That means the line isn't syncing. I'll raise a ticket and a technician will visit tomorrow between 10 and 12.
Fine. Please make sure someone actually turns up this time.
I've marked it as priority. You'll get a text confirmation shortly.
Okay team, quick standup. Where are we on the release?
Backend is done, I'm waiting on the QA pass for the payments module.
The staging database was down yesterday, that cost us half a day.
Understood. I'll ask infra to look at it. Let's ship Thursday if QA clears by Wednesday.
Thanks for calling Brightnet, how can I help?
My internet is slow in the evenings.
I see you are on the 50 megabit plan. Many families find that too slow now. We have a 200 megabit plan for just 15 dollars more per month.
Hmm, how much exactly would it be in total?
Sixty-four dollars a month with a free router upgrade if you sign a 12 month term today.
Let me think about it and talk to my partner.
